originalSubject: Re: Hashtag Web3: publisher onboarding and automatic news-feed distribution

payload.subject: Re: Hashtag Web3: publisher onboarding and automatic news-feed distribution
payload.text:
Hello CoinCheckup team,

To answer your question: we are proposing a free content-syndication arrangement - no fees in either direction, and no paid licensing required from you.

Concretely, what we offer at no cost:

- Ongoing supply of our native news articles through our RSS feed: https://hashtagweb3.com/news/feed.xml (headlines, summaries, original publication dates, canonical links back to hashtagweb3.com)
- Attribution to Hashtag Web3 as the publisher and canonical links to the original article on our site - we are not proposing rewriting or republishing without attribution
- Image-rights information for our original images where required

If CoinCheckup's program requires a standard partnership or licensing agreement, we are open to reviewing it, but our proposal itself is a free syndication arrangement.

Publication: https://hashtagweb3.com/news
About: https://hashtagweb3.com/about
Example native article: https://hashtagweb3.com/bitgetthai

Editorially, our workflow uses AI-assisted research and drafting with source and publication checks. Our news listing also links to external publishers; those external stories are not supplied as our own content. Please advise on your AI-disclosure requirements and next steps.

Thank you,
Hashtag Web3 - hi@hashtagweb3.com
